trial_court: Principal District & Sessions Judge, East District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi (Crl. Appeal No. 95/2024, Crl. Appeal No. 96/2024, Crl. Appeal No. 97/2024)
case_name: Pradeep Jain vs Kunal Ajay Singh And Ors
facts_of_case: Three complaint cases were instituted by the respondent on the same day for dishonoured cheques issued by the accused. The trial court convicted and sentenced the accused. The appeals are against the judgment of conviction dated 30-3-2024 and order on sentence dated 14-5-2024.

legal_principles.principle: The accused can show that the 'stop payment' instructions were not issued because of insufficiency or paucity of funds.
legal_principles.held: If the accused shows that in his account there are sufficient funds to clear the amount of the cheque at the time of presentation of the cheque for encashment at the drawer bank and that the stop payment notice had been issued because of other valid causes including that there was no existing debt or liability at the time of presumption of cheque for encashment, then offence under Section 138 would not be made out.
cited_cases: M/s. M.M.T.C. Ltd. vs. M/s. Medchal Chemicals & Pharma P. Ltd., (2002) 1 SCC 234
Laxmi Dyechem (M/s.) vs. State of Gujarat, 2012 XII AD (SC) 161
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — applies to all cheque bounce cases

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to show that stop payment instructions were not issued because of insufficiency or paucity of funds.
legal_principles.held: The important thing is that the burden of so proving would be on the accused.
cited_cases: M/s. M.M.T.C. Ltd. vs. M/s. Medchal Chemicals & Pharma P. Ltd., (2002) 1 SCC 234
Laxmi Dyechem (M/s.) vs. State of Gujarat, 2012 XII AD (SC) 161
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — applies to all cheque bounce cases

outcome.final_order: The accused was awarded substantive sentence of simple imprisonment of three months. He was directed to pay different amounts of fine in all the three matters equal to total cheques amount, along with simple interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of the complaints till the date of judgments.

use_for_drafting: drafting a complaint case for cheque bounce
appealing a judgment of conviction in a cheque bounce case
defending against an order on sentence in a cheque bounce case
